user.title: Connect to Cosysense
user.description: Enter the app client ID and refresh token Cosysense gave you. They are read-only and cover only the sites you were granted.

site.title: Choose sites
site.description: Each site becomes its own entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Cosysense needs a new token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {site} was rejected. It may have expired (tokens last 90 days) or been revoked. Enter a new one.

error.invalid_auth: The client ID or refresh token was rejected.
error.https_required: The API address must start with https://.
error.site_not_granted: This token does not cover this site.

abort.already_configured: All sites this token covers are already added.

data.levels: Only show these buildings and levels (empty shows all)
